gaps.sentence: ___ the circumstances, the committee chose leniency.
The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: Everything happened ___ such short notice that we panicked.
The smell was ___ this world — absolutely incredible.
The letter arrived ___ due course — three weeks later.
gaps.hint: ___ due course = at the expected time
gaps.explanation: 'in due course' = at the proper time eventually.

gaps.sentence: The castle dates ___ to the fourteenth century.
The neighbours complained ___ the noise until dawn.
gaps.explanation: complain ABOUT something; 'in the small hours' = after midnight. Only the first gap is checked.

gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.
